register.reg_long_name: PLB Invalidate All, EL3, Inner Shareable
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_S1POE2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Invalidates cached copies of IRT, TTT, and DPOT entries from PLBs that meet all the following requirements:

listitem.content: The entry would be used in the EL3 translation regime in the current Security state.

purpose_text.para: The invalidation applies to all PEs in the same Inner Shareable shareability domain as the PE that executes this System instruction.

attributes_text.para: PLBI ALLE3IS, PLBI ALLE3ISNXS is a 64-bit System instruction.

access_permission_text.para: The Rt field should be set to 0b11111. If the Rt field is not set to 0b11111, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether:

content.para: The instruction behaves as if the Rt field is set to 0b11111.

access_permission_text.para: This system instruction is an alias of the SYS instruction.
